profile.label: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.usernameHint: @name · 3-20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscore
profile.usernameLength: The username must be 3 to 20 characters long.
profile.usernameFormat: A username can contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
profile.avatarInvalid: Pick an image up to 10 MB.
profile.publicProfileHint: Your name and avatar appear on the weekly leaderboard. Your email is never shown. The avatar is publicly reachable via its link.

plan.label: Plan
plan.meta: {{date}} · {{days}} days per week · phases: base → build → peak → taper
plan.benchmarkHint: Form changes. A benchmark refreshes the paces across your plan.
plan.newPlan: New plan (the old one is archived)
plan.runDaysHint: Tap a day to include or exclude it. The long run is colour-coded.
plan.generated: The new plan is ready, the old one is archived.
plan.raceRegenerate: Regenerate the plan with the new details
plan.raceEditFailed: Saving the race failed. Please try again.
plan.generateFailed: The plan couldn't be generated. Please try again.
plan.baseConfirmText: Without a goal time or a race result, the plan has no quality workouts or target paces. You only get easy running. Continue?

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Import your runs from health apps.
integrations.webHint: Run import works in the RunCast app on your phone, through Apple Health and Health Connect.
integrations.permissionDenied: Access was not granted. Allow it in Health or Health Connect.
integrations.noneNew: No new runs since the last import.
integrations.noneOrDenied: No runs found or access is not allowed. Check Health or Health Connect.
integrations.autosyncHint: Import new runs when you open RunCast.
integrations.needsInstall: The Health Connect app is required.
integrations.needsInstallHint: Install it from the Play Store, then come back to RunCast.
integrations.xiaomiIos: Xiaomi: Mi Fitness → Profile → Third-party data → Health (enable cloud sync).
integrations.xiaomiAndroid: Xiaomi: Mi Fitness/Zepp Life → Third-party data → Google Fit, then Google Fit → Sync with Health Connect.
integrations.privacy: Data stays on your phone. RunCast stores only the date, distance and duration of a run.
integrations.consent: Importing is voluntary and started by you. Imported runs stay linked to your account.
integrations.readinessHint: Sleep, HRV and resting heart rate are read only when this is on. They are processed locally on your phone and never leave the device.

push.label: Notifications
push.hint: Choose what you want to get. The morning brief arrives at 7, the rest at the hour you pick.
push.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
push.denied: Notification permission was denied. Allow notifications in your browser settings; on iPhone add the app to the Home Screen first.
push.unavailable: Push service unavailable. Check your connection and that the app is installed, then try again.
push.notConfigured: Notifications aren't configured on the server yet. Try again later.

gear.label: Gear
gear.name: Shoe name
gear.empty: No shoes yet. Add your first pair and keep an eye on the miles.
gear.deleteText: {{name}} will be removed from your gear. Your runs stay logged, just without shoes.
gear.hint: Assign your shoes when logging a workout to track mileage

account.label: Account
account.emailHint: Your email is used for sign in and is never shown to others.
account.exportHint: You get a JSON file with your profile, plan, workouts, run log and gear.
account.deleteIrreversible: This action cannot be undone. Your account and all data are deleted right away.
